next_step_summary: PR #266 is the first owner-authorized bounded corrective after the provider batch audit. It removes gemini-3.1-pro-preview from the API route, leaving gemini-3.6-flash -> gemini-3.5-flash, validates model override before provider access, and adds run-scoped memory so daily-quota or stable 403/404-unavailable models are skipped by later cases. Malformed-output fallback, structured quota/retry parsing, separate bounded retry/routing budgets, attempt ledger/per-model metrics, and guaranteed partial-report persistence remain the immediately following corrective before any new Gemini run.
